categories.name: Wires & Cables
categories.description: A complete range of low-voltage wires and cables built on electrolytic-grade bare and tinned copper conductors, with insulation systems selected for the electrical, thermal and mechanical stresses of each application.

nodes.name: Automotive Cables
nodes.description: Single-core low-voltage cables for vehicle wiring, produced in JASO, JIS, DIN and ISO constructions with wall thicknesses matched to harness weight and routing targets.

products.name: AV
products.description: AV is the standard-wall PVC insulated automotive cable to JASO D 611 / JIS C 3406. The thicker insulation wall gives generous abrasion and cut-through resistance, making it the default choice for engine-bay and chassis routes where the harness is exposed to handling damage.
features: Annealed bare copper conductor, class 5 flexibility
Heat-resistant PVC insulation rated 80 °C continuous
High abrasion and cut-through resistance
Full colour and stripe identification range

products.name: AVS
products.description: AVS carries the same conductor as AV with a reduced insulation wall, cutting overall diameter and harness weight without giving up the electrical rating. It is the usual specification where bundle diameter through grommets and connectors is the limiting factor.
features: Reduced wall for smaller bundle diameter
Lower harness weight per metre than AV
Consistent insulation concentricity for reliable crimping
Compatible with standard automotive terminals

products.name: AVSS
products.description: AVSS takes the thin-wall concept to its practical limit, with the smallest outer diameter of the JASO family. It is specified where weight reduction and routing through tight cross-sections matter most, typically in high-density modern harness architectures.
features: Smallest outer diameter in the AV family
Maximum weight saving for dense harnesses
Tight dimensional tolerance for automated cutting and crimping
Stable insulation properties after thermal ageing

products.name: DIN
products.description: DIN-type automotive cable in FLRY and FLRYY constructions to ISO 6722 and DIN 72551, supplied in metric conductor sizes for European vehicle platforms and machinery builders working to German drawing standards.
features: Metric conductor sizing to ISO 6722
FLRY-A / FLRY-B wall options
Resistant to automotive fluids and greases
Long-term thermal endurance at rated class

nodes.name: Travelling / Elevator Cables
nodes.description: Flat and round travelling cables engineered for continuous flexing in lift shafts, with strain-bearing members that carry the suspended weight so the conductors never do.

products.name: Flat Travelling Cables
products.tagline: Power and control for lift cars
products.description: Flat elevator travelling cables carry power and control circuits between the shaft and the moving car. The flat profile suppresses twisting, and textile or steel strain-bearing members take the full suspended load so conductors see no tension over millions of travel cycles.
features: Anti-twist flat profile for stable hanging loops
Integral strain-bearing members carry suspended weight
Flexible class 5 copper conductors for continuous flexing
Flame-retardant sheath to IEC 60332-1

specs.label: Travel height
specs.value: Constructions for up to 150 m and above

products.name: Data Transmission Cables
products.description: Travelling cables with screened twisted pairs alongside the power cores, so intercom, display, serial bus and control signalling ride the same run as the supply without picking up interference from the drive.
features: Individually screened twisted pairs
Controlled impedance for stable signal runs
Power and data combined in a single travelling cable
Drain wire provided for clean earthing at both ends

specs.label: Pairs
specs.value: 1 – 8 screened pairs, combined with power cores

products.name: Data / IP Camera Cables
products.description: Composite travelling cables that combine camera supply cores with screened data or coaxial elements, letting a single run feed IP and analogue surveillance inside the lift car without a second suspended cable.
features: Power cores and video elements in one flexing cable
Screened elements keep video clear of drive noise
Suitable for PoE and externally powered cameras
Strain members rated for full shaft travel

products.name: CAT-6 Travelling Cables
products.description: Flat travelling cables with an integrated CAT-6 four-pair element, rated for continuous flexing. They bring gigabit Ethernet to the lift car for displays, IP intercoms, remote diagnostics and cameras on a single certified run.
features: CAT-6 four-pair element qualified for flexing duty
Supports 1 Gbps Ethernet and PoE devices
Combined with power and control cores as required
Consistent impedance maintained through the travel loop

nodes.name: Submersible Cable
nodes.tagline: Flat cable for borewell pump motors
nodes.description: Flat three-core submersible pump cable built for permanent immersion. The insulation and sheath compounds are selected for water resistance and dimensional stability at depth, and the flat profile lets the cable be clamped along the riser pipe without bulk.
features: Rated for continuous immersion in water
Flat profile clamps neatly to the riser pipe
High-purity annealed copper for low voltage drop over long drops
Tough sheath resists abrasion during installation and withdrawal

nodes.name: Instrumentation Cables
nodes.tagline: Screened pairs and triads for process signals
nodes.description: Instrumentation cables for 4-20 mA loops, RTD, thermocouple and fieldbus signalling, available with individual screens, overall screen or both, and with armour where the route runs through plant areas.
features: Individual and overall screening options
Pairs or triads with colour-coded, numbered cores
Steel wire or galvanised strip armour available
Flame-retardant and FRLS sheath options

nodes.name: Solar Cables
nodes.tagline: DC cable for rooftop and utility scale PV
nodes.description: Halogen-free, cross-linked DC cable for photovoltaic strings and combiner runs. The XLPO insulation and sheath are rated for a 25-year design life under UV, ozone and wide temperature swings on exposed rooftops and open ground mounts.
features: Halogen-free cross-linked insulation and sheath
UV, ozone and weather resistant for outdoor runs
Tinned copper conductor resists long-term oxidation
25-year design life at rated conditions

nodes.name: Data Center Cables
nodes.tagline: Low-smoke power and data for white space
nodes.description: Power and data cables specified for data centre white space and plant rooms, with low-smoke zero-halogen compounds that limit smoke and corrosive gas in a fire, and flexible constructions suited to dense containment and underfloor routing.
features: Low-smoke zero-halogen sheath for occupied technical spaces
Flame retardant to IEC 60332-3 category tests
Flexible constructions for dense cable management
Power, control and CAT-6A/6 data variants

specs.label: Types
specs.value: LSZH power, control and structured data

nodes.name: Domestic Cables
nodes.description: House wiring cable for residential and commercial building circuits, drawn and insulated to IS 694 with FR and FRLS compound options.

products.name: Single Core PVC Insulated Cables
products.description: Single-core PVC insulated building wire on electrolytic bright annealed copper, supplied in FR and FRLS compounds. Uniform insulation thickness and consistent conductor resistance keep voltage drop predictable across long conduit runs.
features: Electrolytic bright annealed 99.97% copper conductor
FR and FRLS compound options
Uniform wall thickness for easy stripping and termination
Full colour range for phase, neutral and earth identification

nodes.name: Industrial Cables
nodes.description: Flexible single and multicore cables for machine building, panel wiring and plant distribution, made to take vibration, oil and repeated movement.

products.name: Flexible Wires
products.description: Single-core flexible wire with fine-stranded class 5 copper for panel wiring, appliance internals and equipment builds where the conductor has to be routed tightly and terminated by hand.
features: Fine-stranded class 5 conductor for tight bends
Consistent stranding for reliable ferrule crimps
FR and FRLS compound options
Wide colour range for circuit identification

products.name: Multicore Flexible Wires
products.description: Round sheathed flexible cables in two to five cores for portable equipment, machinery supply and appliance cordage. The extruded inner filler keeps the cross-section round so glands and strain reliefs seal properly.
features: Round, filled construction for reliable gland sealing
Class 5 conductors for repeated handling and movement
Tough PVC sheath resists oil splash and abrasion
Available screened for drive and motor circuits

products.name: Multicore Industrial Cables
products.description: Multicore control cables in high core counts for plant control, interlocks and signalling. Cores are numbered and laid up in concentric layers, with screen and armour options for routes that run beside power cables.
features: Numbered cores laid up in concentric layers
Up to 61 cores in standard constructions
Screened and armoured variants available
FRLS and LSZH sheath options

nodes.name: Screen / Braided Cables
nodes.description: Screened and braided cables for circuits that must neither emit nor absorb interference. Coverage is set by application, from foil screens for static shielding through to high-coverage tinned copper braid for variable-speed drive and RF-noisy environments.
features: Tinned copper braid coverage from 65% to 90%
Foil, braid or combined foil-plus-braid screening
360° screen termination supported at both ends
Single and multicore constructions

specs.label: Conductor
specs.value: Flexible annealed or tinned copper, class 5

specs.label: Screen
specs.value: Tinned copper braid and/or Al-polyester foil

categories.name: Power Cords
categories.description: Moulded and assembled cordsets built to the plug standards of the markets you ship to, with matched cable and end connectors so the finished assembly carries one coherent approval story.

nodes.name: Indian Plugs
nodes.tagline: IS 1293 two and three pin cordsets
nodes.description: Moulded Indian-standard plugs in 6 A and 16 A ratings, two and three pin, supplied as complete cordsets with the flexible cable of your choice. Pin geometry and insulation shrouding follow IS 1293 so the assembly drops straight into a BIS-scope product.
features: 6 A and 16 A ratings, 2 pin and 3 pin
Shrouded live and neutral pins
Solid brass pins with nickel plating
Moulded strain relief tested for pull and flex

nodes.name: European Plugs
nodes.description: European cordsets in CEE 7/7 Schuko and CEE 7/16 Europlug formats, moulded onto H03VV-F and H05VV-F cable to match the appliance class and current draw.
features: CEE 7/7 earthed and CEE 7/16 unearthed options
Harmonised H03VV-F / H05VV-F cable
Angled and straight body styles
Halogen-free compound available on request

nodes.name: UK Plugs
nodes.description: BS 1363 three-pin cordsets with an integral fuse carrier, fitted with 3 A, 5 A or 13 A fuses to suit the appliance load. Built for the UK, Ireland and other BS 1363 markets.
features: Integral fuse carrier, 3 A / 5 A / 13 A
Insulated shrouds on live and neutral pins
Moulded body with anti-kink strain relief
Fuse links to BS 1362

nodes.name: Australian Plugs
nodes.description: Flat-pin cordsets to AS/NZS 3112 for the Australian and New Zealand markets, in earthed and unearthed formats with insulated pin shrouds as required by the current standard.
features: Earthed 3 pin and unearthed 2 pin formats
Insulated pin shrouds per current AS/NZS revision
10 A standard rating, higher ratings to order
Straight and right-angle bodies

nodes.name: African Plugs
nodes.description: Cordsets for African markets in SANS 164 and round-pin BS 546 formats, covering both the legacy 15 A South African plug and the newer compact SANS 164-2 standard.
features: SANS 164-1 (15 A) and SANS 164-2 formats
Round-pin BS 546 5 A / 15 A options
Solid brass pins, corrosion protected
Moulded strain relief for heavy handling

nodes.name: American / Japanese Plugs
nodes.description: NEMA 1-15P and 5-15P cordsets for North America, and JIS C 8303 cordsets for Japan, built on SPT, SVT and SJT cable to match the appliance class and cord duty.
features: NEMA 1-15P and 5-15P configurations
JIS C 8303 two and three pin formats
SPT-2, SVT, SJT cable options
Polarised and non-polarised variants

nodes.name: IEC End Connectors
nodes.description: IEC 60320 appliance couplers moulded to the far end of a cordset, covering the hot and cold condition connectors most equipment uses: C5, C7, C13, C15 and C19.
features: C5, C7, C13, C15, C19 connector bodies
Straight and right-angle outlets
Locking variants available for rack use
Temperature classes matched to appliance rating

specs.label: Cable
specs.value: Matched to plug end and load

nodes.name: M12 Connectors
nodes.tagline: Sealed circular connectors for the factory floor
nodes.description: Overmoulded M12 circular connector leads for sensors, actuators and industrial Ethernet. A-coded for signal and power, D- and X-coded for Ethernet, all sealed to IP67 when mated.
features: A, B, D and X coding options
IP67 sealing when correctly mated
Straight and right-angle overmoulds
3, 4, 5, 8 and 12 pole configurations

nodes.name: Customised Plugs
nodes.tagline: Tooling and overmoulds to your drawing
nodes.description: Purpose-built plug and connector overmoulds developed against your drawing: custom body geometry, colours, branding, cable exits and lead lengths, taken from sample through to series production.
features: Custom tooling developed against your drawing
Brand marking, colour matching and cable printing
Special cable exits and strain relief geometry
Sample, pilot and series production support

specs.label: Branding
specs.value: Embossed logo, custom colours, printed cable

nodes.name: Terminals & Cable Holders
nodes.description: Crimp terminals, ferrules, cord grips and cable holders that finish an assembly: ring, fork, bullet and blade terminals in insulated and uninsulated forms, plus the strain relief hardware that keeps them in service.
features: Ring, fork, bullet, blade and pin terminals
Insulated and uninsulated forms
Wire ferrules across the common size range
Cord grips, clamps and strain relief bushes

specs.label: Insulation
specs.value: Nylon or PVC sleeves, colour coded

specs.label: Crimping
specs.value: Applied to spec with calibrated tooling

specs.label: Packing
specs.value: Bulk, reel or kitted per assembly

nodes.name: Spiral Retractile Cords
nodes.tagline: Coiled cords that return to length
nodes.description: Heat-set spiral cords that extend under load and pull back to their retracted length. Coil diameter, pitch, retracted and extended lengths and tail lengths are all set to your application.
features: Heat-set coils with stable memory over cycle life
Retracted and extended lengths built to specification
PVC, PUR and TPE sheath options
Screened variants for signal and drive circuits

specs.label: Geometry
specs.value: Coil OD, pitch and tails made to order

categories.name: Wire Harnesses
categories.description: Complete harness assembly to your drawing and bill of materials, from prototype through to series supply, with continuity and hipot testing on every assembly before it leaves the floor.

nodes.name: Custom Wire Harnesses
nodes.description: We build wire harnesses to your print: cut and strip, applicator crimping, connector loading, taping, sleeving, routing on form boards, and 100% electrical test. Workmanship follows IPC/WHMA-A-620 classes, and first-article samples are documented before any series run starts.
features: Automated cut, strip and applicator crimping
Crimp height and pull-force monitoring against spec
100% continuity and hipot testing on every assembly
IPC/WHMA-A-620 workmanship classes
Form-board routing for repeatable branch geometry

specs.label: Termination
specs.value: Crimp, solder, IDC, ring and blade terminals

specs.label: Protection
specs.value: Convoluted tube, braided sleeve, tape, heat shrink
